findings.claim: live MambaBlock has no dt initialization
findings.note: canonical norm_topology=hybrid is the WORST case; identical correct init already exists as dead code at mamba_block_v2.py:159-179

findings.claim: dt_norm (RMSNorm on Delta before softplus) erases the proposed dt init
findings.verdict: NEW — missed by the source analysis
findings.consequence: applying the dt_proj init without touching dt_norm is a NO-OP on every v2 config. Mamba-3 S3.4 normalizes B and C only, never Delta.

findings.refutes: source analysis claim that the dt init alone 'moves your current scan back into its correct regime' — it does not
findings.mechanism: where A_cum[s] underflows to 0 while A_cum_safe[s]=1e-8, h_intra[s] = 0 * (Bx[s]/1e-8) = 0 — the current token's own contribution to the state is annihilated

findings.claim: the proposed reference segsum ports directly
findings.reason: Mamba-2/3 segsum is cheap because A_t is scalar per head giving a (cs,cs) mask. This repo is Mamba-1 style with A of shape (d_inner, d_state), so the mask is (cs,cs,d,n).

verified_alternative.caveat: only works once Delta is initialized; at uninitialized Delta=0.705 even chunk=2 fails (rel err 0.398) — M1 and M2 are COUPLED and must land together

findings.claim: existing tests should have caught this
findings.evidence: tests/test_kernels.py::test_scan_forward asserts only shape / no-NaN / no-Inf, never numerical correctness, and is CUDA-gated so it never runs in validate_for_willi.sh
tfla_interface.py:149 already uses the log-space difference form for inter-chunk decay; :93-95 still divides by f_cum.clamp(min=1e-6) for intra-chunk. Only the intra-chunk half needs work.

notes: 2026-08-16: PLAN CREATED. Pre-implementation audit of 7 proposed Mamba-3 changes against commit 7104902, all numbers reproduced on CPU with a float64 sequential reference. Verdict: 4 confirmed, 1 refuted in its prescription, 2 unverifiable-but-plausible. TWO FINDINGS THE SOURCE ANALYSIS MISSED: (F2) dt_norm rescales Delta to unit RMS before softplus, so the proposed dt init is a NO-OP on the canonical norm_topology=hybrid config — target Delta mean 0.021 lands at 0.332; (F4) the proposed segsum does not port because this repo's A is (d_inner,d_state) not scalar-per-head, making the mask (cs,cs,d,n) = 19.3 GB at chunk=64/bs=48. REFUTED: the claim that the dt init alone fixes the scan — under the proposed init 29.7% of channels still exceed 1% error. Verified cheap alternative: chunk_size<=8 is exact (1.5e-16), but only once Delta is initialized, so M1 and M2 are coupled.

2026-08-16: STRATEGIC CONSTRAINT RECORDED. All 7 changes are text-backbone changes. H100_SCALING_PLAN.md records 10 nulls including 'Stage-0 PPL 15.62->13.18 = flat' and '70M->150M = flat'. Success metric for this plan is therefore Stage-0 PPL + operator correctness; retrieval is a non-regression guard only. Gating any phase here on MIMIC R@10 would repeat the error the 2026-07-25 post-mortem documents.

2026-08-16: SCOPE NOTE. The defect does NOT invalidate published results — training and eval used the same operator, so MIMIC 0.1459 (clean) / 0.1714 (val==test) remain valid measurements of the system as built. The defensible narrower claim: the block did not compute the Mamba recurrence it was specified to compute.
